title: Manzwi Akazvipira Ari Parutivi Pemuporofita
intro: Munyika iri kure, mutumwa ane chiremera akatarisana nekurambwa zvakanyanya nemasimba ekutonga enguva iyoyo. Asi boka diki revanhu vakazvipira rakamira parutivi pemuranda uyu waAllah, richida kupindura kudanwa kwaMwari. Kutenda kwavo kwakasimba kwaizoparadzanisa rudzi rune simba uye pakupedzisira kukunda masimba ekusatenda.
clues: Taiva boka diki rakazvipira, rakabatana mukutenda nechinangwa.
Takamira padivi pemutumwa ane mukurumbira uyo akarambwa nemasimba ane simba enyika yavo.
Mutumwa uyu paakabvunza kuti, 'Ndivanaani vatsigiri vangu mubasa raAllah?' takapindura tisingazenguriri.
Takakumbira mutumwa uyu kuti atsvage mabiko kubva kudenga kuti atipe vimbiso kumoyo yedu.
Pakati pevanhu venguva iyoyo, vamwe vakatenda kuburikidza neshoko redu uye vamwe vakaramba nehasha, asi Allah akasimbisa vatendi.
Isu tiri maHawwariyyun — vadzidzi vakazvipira vaIsa, vakakundwa kuburikidza nerutsigiro rwaAllah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
